text:
zoe.ae: Heads-up — Halcyon Labs put their POC on hold. Procurement says they need a signed data-residency attestation and a firm pilot spend ceiling before legal will issue the PO. Can Sec/Eng join a 20m sync today?

miguel.presales: I can take it. Do we have a short attestation template Legal prefers or should Sec draft a one-pager? Also: is the cap meant to be total for 30 days or weekly?

anya.sec: We have a template we can adapt quickly: region lock, no outbound raw-data egress without written approval, audit log retention. Need to confirm KMS preference (BYOK vs Redwood KMS) and whether they demand HSM attestation.

karim.eng: For Dedicated VPC we can stand up a pilot in ~72 hours. On-prem adds several weeks. If they require model pinning or quantization to meet regs, we should run a short compatibility test against their sample corpus.

lee.csm: Procurement insists on a hard cap for the 30-day pilot. Finance must approve any figure. I can surface exec sponsor once attestation is signed.

miguel.presales: Proposed pitch: 30-day Dedicated pilot, optional BYOK, pilot cap $7,500 total or $0.0010/token overage (customer-favoring). Can Finance/Rev confirm?

anya.sec: OK to present as a draft. Draft attestation for Legal review:

anya.sec: ```
Data Residency Attestation (draft)
- Customer data processed only within region: eu-north-1.
- No export of raw customer data outside the region without express customer approval.
- Customer may elect BYOK; Redwood supports both customer-managed keys and Redwood KMS with HSM.
- Inference request audit logs retained for 90 days and available on request.
```

zoe.ae: @escalation-bot please open an internal ticket to track approvers/owners.

escalation-bot: Created ticket SD-9986 (Halcyon POC BoardHold). Assigned: miguel.presales, anya.sec, legal-team.

karim.eng: Risk note: if the customer requires pinning to a quantized model, latency and throughput may shift. Recommend a 45min compatibility run with their sanitized samples before the exec call. Who will upload samples?

lee.csm: Uploading sanitized sample set to secure share and inviting Eng/Sec now.

miguel.presales: Finance/Rev — please confirm we can hold to $7.5k cap for the 30-day pilot or advise alternative ASAP so we can present their CTO/CISO.

zoe.ae: Plan if Finance ok: 1) Send draft attestation + pricing cap to customer today, 2) schedule 20-30m CTO/CISO call tomorrow with our execs, 3) run compatibility test once samples in. Target: PO released by Friday EOD.

anya.sec: Legal requested addendum: "Redwood to provide SOC2 report and completed security questionnaire within 48 hours of request." Getting legal eyes now.

karim.eng: Reserving a staging Dedicated cluster slot; if BYOK, start KMS onboarding (24-48h).

lee.csm: Customer DM: on-prem only if audit strictly requires; they'd prefer VPC pilot. Proposing 3pm or 10am for the exec sync.

miguel.presales: 3pm works for our execs. Zoe, can you send invite with draft attestation attached once Legal signals ok?

escalation-bot: SD-9986 status -> "awaiting legal review"

zoe.ae: Thanks team — pushing to Legal now. Will post signed attestation and finance confirmation back in this thread. If Legal stalls we may need an earlier exec intro.

miguel.presales: I'll also prepare a short SLA addendum to attach (simple uptime + response window) in case procurement asks.

anya.sec: One final ask — confirm whether Halcyon requires physical air-gapped on-prem. If not, Dedicated/VPC keeps timeline short.

lee.csm: Confirmed: on-prem only if audit mandates. Updating customer with our draft and tentative 3pm slot. :thumbsup:
